statements.subject: connection
statements.description: One or more Ack Vector options that, together, report the status of a packet with a sequence number less than ISN, the initial sequence number, SHOULD be considered invalid. The receiving DCCP SHOULD either ignore the options or reset the connection with Reset Code 5, "Option Error".
statements.trigger: AckVector option references sequence number less than ISN
actions: send Reset with Reset Code 5 Option Error
